parameters.command:
echo '===SECRETS==='; cat /srv/altek/.secrets.json 2>/dev/null; echo '===FILES===';
M=/home/node/.n8n/.lastcheck_analyze
[ -f "$M" ] || touch -d '1 hour ago' "$M"
OUT=/srv/altek/.unzip_tmp
mkdir -p "$OUT"
find "$OUT" -maxdepth 1 -name "run_*" -mmin +30 -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null
rm -rf "$OUT"/run_* 2>/dev/null
find /srv/altek/Сотрудники -path '*/Документы_тендера/*' -type f -newer "$M" \( -iname '*.pdf' -o -iname '*.docx' -o -iname '*.doc' -o -iname '*.xlsx' -o -iname '*.xls' -o -iname '*.txt' -o -iname '*.zip' \) ! -path '*/.*' 2>/dev/null > "$OUT/.list"
find /srv/altek/Сотрудники -path '*/Заявка/*' -type f -newer "$M" \( -iname '*.pdf' -o -iname '*.docx' -o -iname '*.doc' -o -iname '*.xlsx' -o -iname '*.xls' -o -iname '*.txt' -o -iname '*.zip' \) ! -path '*/.*' 2>/dev/null >> "$OUT/.list"
cat "$OUT/.list" | while IFS= read -r f; do
  rel="${f#/srv/altek/Сотрудники/}"
  m="${rel%%/*}"
  b=$(basename "$f")
  case "$b" in
    *.zip|*.ZIP)
      sub="$OUT/run_$(date +%s)_$$"
      mkdir -p "$sub"
      unzip -o -j "$f" -d "$sub" >/dev/null 2>&1
      i=0
      find "$sub" -type f | sort | while IFS= read -r x; do
        i=$((i+1)); ext="${x##*.}"; ext=$(echo "$ext" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z')
        nf="$sub/doc$i.$ext"
        mv "$x" "$nf" 2>/dev/null || true
        printf '%s\t%s\t%s [%s]\n' "$m" "$nf" "$b" "$i"
      done
      ;;
    *) printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$m" "$f" "$b" ;;
  esac
done
touch "$M"
